# Thunderbird established Phabricator patch-review workflow

Fetch exact revisions with `moz-phab patch --raw --skip-dependencies D####`, record the SHA-256 digest, and never silently review local `HEAD`. Import only in `Review comm checkout`, not a sibling clone or Git worktree; invoke `[local path]` explicitly. [Task 1][Task 2]

Scope: general.
